title: Cashiering Rules for RV & Boat Storage Payments, Returned Payments and Gate Cards
content:
**Rule 1 — channels and application.** RV & Boat Storage payments are accepted through the payment channels accepted for storage rent and fees, and each payment is applied to the oldest charge first. A payment may cover several months at once, as a prepayment does.

**Rule 2 — returned payments.** A returned payment is charged back for exactly the returned amount against that payment, and the returned-payment fee of the space class is charged with it. The returned-payment fee is dated the date of the return and is tied to the same returned payment.

**Rule 3 — one chargeback per payment.** A payment is charged back only once. Whether a payment has already been charged back is read from the rental's own entries: a returned-payment chargeback already recorded against that payment means it is not charged back again.

**Rule 4 — gate cards.** A replacement gate card is charged the gate-card replacement fee.

### Input — judgement — output

| Input | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| A hypothetical 95.00 personal check returned unpaid by the bank; no chargeback yet recorded against it | first return of that payment | a chargeback of exactly 95.00 against that check, and the returned-payment fee with it |
| The same check reported returned a second time | a chargeback already exists against that payment | no second chargeback |
| A hypothetical payment of 150.00 received while a 30.00 fee from an earlier month and this month's 128.00 rent are both open | oldest charge first | 30.00 to the earlier fee, 120.00 to this month's rent |
| A renter's gate card is lost and a replacement is issued | replacement card | the gate-card replacement fee is charged |

### Basis Q&A

*Is the chargeback the full amount of the original payment or only part of it?* Exactly the amount returned, against that payment.

*Does a returned payment carry a fee?* Yes, the returned-payment fee is charged with the chargeback.

*In what order does a payment settle open charges?* Oldest charge first.
